arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Clement argued the government can protect the public from fraud.
Mr. Huszagh stated charitable solicitors cannot commit fraud freely.
Mr. Copilevitz argued fundraising costs reflect protected persuasive speech.
Mr. Huszagh corrected the record regarding the affidavit treatment.
